clusters.title: Task ownership and recovery
clusters.benefit: One durable ownership/budget/repair authority; crash and duplicate-work failures share one transaction boundary.
clusters.test: Restart and competing-attempt schedules preserve ownership, cost and unresolved obligations.

clusters.title: Worker routing and capability
clusters.benefit: Task-aware policy composes with maintained provider/agent runtimes.
clusters.test: Two real adapter types return effective identity, usage, limitations and cancellation.

clusters.title: Thread context and cohesion
clusters.benefit: Durable bounded briefs and actionable feedback connect specialists without transcript broadcast.
clusters.test: Obsolete briefs, missing acknowledgements and conflicting ownership cannot masquerade as progress.

clusters.title: Verification and numerical evidence
clusters.benefit: Actual candidate checks and Julia outcome analysis improve choices while preserving separate authority.
clusters.test: False completion and misleading numerical reports fail closed against independent fixtures.

clusters.title: Habitat operation and presentation
clusters.benefit: Herdr visibility and established lifecycle ownership expose useful state without an LLM status interpreter.
clusters.test: Pane reconnect, stalled services and control denial preserve task truth.

clusters.title: Application assembly
clusters.benefit: One composition root assembles narrow modules; dependency direction remains visible.
clusters.test: Packaged full-stack loop reaches accepted completion and delivery with the intended adapters.

flows.request_context: Versioned intent and operator constraints enter actions/app; authenticated task-scoped request reaches task
flows.return_context: Status, route reason, blocking criterion and completion references
flows.closure_check: Pane loss does not lose the task; a displayed done message cannot accept it.

flows.request_context: Expected state/generation plus atomic attempt/event changes
flows.return_context: Committed identity or typed conflict/storage failure
flows.closure_check: Crash after commit preserves replayable obligation; same key/different body conflicts.

flows.request_context: Task class, immutable constraints and candidate observations
flows.return_context: Eligible recipe, exclusions, evidence freshness and fallback
flows.closure_check: Ineligible model never dispatches; reverse explanation names every decisive exclusion.

flows.request_context: Capability/locality/version/health query whose returned facts are passed to pure route policy
flows.return_context: Declared and observed facts with identity and age
flows.closure_check: Missing or stale facts retain unknown status; source refresh does not rewrite history.

flows.request_context: Attempt/verification reservation and later measured usage
flows.return_context: Admit/refuse, remaining budget and reconciliation discrepancy
flows.closure_check: Concurrent reservations and unknown usage preserve the declared cost mode.

flows.request_context: Attempt/generation, recipe, owned workspace, limits and cancellation
flows.return_context: Ack/activity, usage, candidate references, exit/error and settled state
flows.closure_check: Every forward dispatch has a reconciled terminal or explicit unknown return; no stale generation acceptance.

flows.request_context: Acceptance revision, immutable candidate and protected fixture references
flows.return_context: Criterion observations, checker errors and raw evidence references
flows.closure_check: Wrong subject, changed fixture, skipped mandatory test or forged pass cannot close.

flows.request_context: Parent criteria, child DAG, thread briefs and resource/budget bounds
flows.return_context: Child candidates, dissent, integration gaps and join readiness
flows.closure_check: Successful children cannot bypass the integrated parent check.

flows.request_context: Current brief revision, role, permitted sources and context limit
flows.return_context: Selected context/artifact pointers, separate source and task-relationship coverage gaps, whole-workflow context cost and provenance
flows.closure_check: Obsolete briefs and missing decisive context produce explicit rescope, not silent full-corpus reload.

flows.request_context: Committed outcome event and relevant recipients
flows.return_context: Delivery receipt or pending/retryable notification state
flows.closure_check: Lost notification retries delivery rather than re-executing accepted work.

flows.request_context: Persisted active attempts and observed process/session identities
flows.return_context: Reconciled state, cleanup result or quarantined ambiguity
flows.closure_check: Expired lease alone cannot release a live writable workspace.

flows.request_context: Immutable dataset, schema/units, analysis recipe and resource bound
flows.return_context: Report/policy candidate, dataset identity, uncertainty and error
flows.closure_check: Rust validates identity/ranges; Julia cannot write leases, grants or accepted status.

flows.request_context: Immutable outcome dataset at declared cutoff, including failed/cancelled/abandoned attempts and unknown usage, plus requested comparison
flows.return_context: Validated quantitative report and candidate-policy disposition
flows.closure_check: A failed or stale analysis leaves the approved baseline unchanged.

flows.request_context: Explicit discovery, cached-state query or specifically approved bounded probe; lifecycle mutation uses F20
flows.return_context: Timestamped useful-health and actual owner/state observation
flows.closure_check: A live PID cannot override a failed request-path probe; discovery grants no control.

flows.request_context: Schema-validated, caller-bound task request and idempotency context
flows.return_context: Admission/state/evidence or typed denial/conflict
flows.closure_check: CLI, Unix API and LLM-tool projections preserve the same authority and effect semantics.

flows.request_context: Typed argv/JSON and caller task context
flows.return_context: Structured result, decisive exit status and evidence references
flows.closure_check: Paths/parameters remain literal and presentation cannot swallow a failing producer.

flows.request_context: Registered tool call, cancellation signal and admitted versions
flows.return_context: Typed result/error, usage, effective identity and evidence
flows.closure_check: Parallel calls and obsolete reload handlers cannot bypass atomic authority or falsify completion.

flows.request_context: Selected skill/version, action compatibility and bounded references
flows.return_context: Task-scoped instructions, source and relationship provenance, explicit omissions and context preparation cost
flows.closure_check: Loading instructions grants no effects; stale/incompatible skill references do not silently execute.

flows.request_context: Versioned finite action composition and expanded child identity, mediated by actions/app with current authority
flows.return_context: Step results, outstanding obligations, repair/stop and parent evidence
flows.closure_check: Every required child and final verifier contributes to the one parent closure path.

flows.request_context: Caller-bound explicit grant, registered service/unit/action and durable operation key
flows.return_context: Lifecycle owner/job identity, observed result/useful health or unknown effect
flows.closure_check: Discovery grants no mutation. Lost manager response requires readback; no competing lifecycle owner.
